title: A week of every bus in Richmond Hill
description:
A week of every bus in Richmond Hill, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Richmond Hill city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: YRT, Viva Blue and GO, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 67 buses, Monday at 7:48 am.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable and leave out Thanksgiving (October 12). October 31 is left out because the clocks change that night. GO Transit ran a reduced timetable on October 10 and 11, so those days are left out. GO Transit changed its timetables during October and has fewer than three usable October Saturdays and Sundays, so its Tuesday, Saturday and Sunday each use one typical date.
